summary.title: Repo health summary
summary.description: One row from `careerbrew report public --out`: gate runs, step failure rate, e2e stories passing, and the last repo checkup's status. Content-free and allowlisted. Refreshed by each /careerbrew-checkup on the machine that ran it; not live, because the numbers exist only on that machine.

steps.title: Gate steps
steps.description: One row per step of scripts/check.sh: runs, failed runs, failure rate, and average seconds in the window. From `careerbrew report public --out`, refreshed by each /careerbrew-checkup.

daily.title: Gate runs per day
daily.description: One row per day: gate runs, step runs, and failed step runs. From `careerbrew report public --out`, refreshed by each /careerbrew-checkup.
